attempts.answer:
The vendor directly providing the software product **Slack** at **slack.com** is **Slack Technologies, LLC** (along with **Slack Technologies Limited** for users outside the United States and Canada), operating as a Salesforce company.

### Supporting Evidence and Citations
* **Privacy Policy (`slack.com/privacy-policy`):**
  > *"When we refer to 'Slack', we mean Slack Technologies, LLC or Slack Technologies Limited, as explained in more detail in the 'Identifying the data controller and processor' section below."*
  > *"This Privacy Policy applies to Slack's online workplace productivity tools and platform, including the associated Slack mobile and desktop applications (collectively, the 'Services'), Slack.com and other Slack websites..."*
* **Legal Terms & Partner Agreements (`slack.com`):**
  > *"The company name is 'Slack Technologies, LLC.'"*
  > Under contracting entity designations: For users domiciled in the United States and Canada, the contracting entity is **Slack Technologies, LLC**; for the rest of the world, it is **Slack Technologies Limited**.
* **Website Notice:**
  > *"© Slack Technologies, LLC, a Salesforce company. All rights reserved."*
